ai.title: Ant Group Releases LingSante-3.1-flash: An Open-Weight MoE Model with 560B Total Parameters and 25B Activations per Token
ai.brief: Ant Group has open-sourced LingSante , a family of medical and health AI models behind health app Afu. 1-flash , is an open-weight medical AI model with 560B total parameters and 25B active per token. It ships under the MIT license with a 1M-token context window. On the new InclusionMed evaluation, it scores highest among open models. It is a self-hostable model trained for clinical reasoning, medical search and tool-using agents. TL;DR What? :It is a self-hostable model trained for clinical reasoning, medical search and tool-using agents. Size: 560B total, ~25B active per token (MoE), 1M-token context. Runs on: Multi-GPU servers. The reference SGLang setup uses 8x H200 or 4x GB300. An MXFP4 quantized checkpoint is available. Performance: Strong on medical reasoning and medical agents. Weaker on general coding and CLI agent tasks. 1-flash? 1-flash base model. It targets complex case analysis and professional medical agents.

sec.title: pCloud Password Manager Hit by Cyber Attack Involving Email Address Exposure and Login Attempts
sec.brief: Cross-platform password manager pCloud Pass has confirmed it was targeted by a cyber attack after users reported seeing unknown devices being connected to their accounts. "A cyber attack targeting pCloud Pass occurred, which was promptly contained by the pCloud team," the Swiss company said in response to a number of posts on Reddit.
